chapter: Wax Records, Broadway shows and Eddie Condon
title: Shows, Pearl Bailey, Louie Bellson and Basie in the 1950s
summary: Hall continues in shows, tours briefly with Pearl Bailey and mentions a 1953 Basie stint.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Now, so, through the end of the '40's, you continued to play in the shows?

Yeah, well, I played in shows up until this last year. I substitute in shows and sub in theaters. I've been invited to come to 'The Wiz' which will close pretty soon. But Mr. (inaudible) is going to try to get another company
to go out on the road. Arvell Shaw is doing it.
So then, what else were you doing then --
No, yeah, in the '40's and into the you know, early '50's, you were still obviously working in the shows.
I was still doing the shows. I was in shows and then I worked with Pearl Bailey. The Louie Belson band worked with Don Redman (inaudible). We traveled a little bit.
Then before that, you mentioned you were with Count Basie's band?
Yeah, and what was that? Was that when he, before he put the band back together again?
Because he had the small group for a couple of years there.
This was just before he recorded the hit --
